mapper.select: select id, post_id as postId, seg, lang_src as langSrc, lang_dst as langDst, status, progress, dur_ms as durMs, cue_count as cueCount, engine, file_path as filePath, err, started_at as startedAt, created_at as createdAt, updated_at as updatedAt, (status = 1 and started_at is not null and started_at < (now() - interval 2 hour)) as stale from tool_web_subtitle where post_id = #{postId} and seg = #{seg} limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into tool_web_subtitle (post_id, seg) values (#{postId}, #{seg}) on duplicate key update id = id
